    The Final Edition models were built to commemorate the conclusion of the GTS production run and feature unique serialized badging, making them highly desirable among collectors worldwide.

    • Final Edition #14 of only 360 produced

    • Legendary 8.0L V10 engine

Showing just 11,113 miles, the car is finished in Viper Red with Stone White racing stripes and is powered by an 8.0-liter V10 paired with a 6-speed manual transmission driving the rear wheels.

    In addition to its limited-production Final Edition status, this example has been fitted with the desirable Hennessey VenomAero body package, which adds aggressive aerodynamic styling while maintaining the car's unmistakable Viper presence.

    Equipment includes:

    • 8.0-liter naturally aspirated V10

    • 6-speed Tremec manual transmission

    • Limited-slip differential

    • Leather seating surfaces

    • Premium sound system

    • Fog lamps

    • Factory Final Edition livery and badging

    • Hennessey VenomAero aerodynamic enhancements

    The Final Edition Vipers were built in limited numbers to mark the end of GTS coupe production and have become some of the most collectible variants of the Viper lineage. Combined with its low mileage, documented Final Edition production number, and Hennessey upgrades, this example offers a compelling opportunity for collectors and enthusiasts seeking a rare and highly recognizable modern American performance car.

    The car is offered with a clean vehicle history report and is believed to be one of the lowest-mileage Final Edition examples currently available on the market.

The 997.2 C4S is the ultimate marriage of things "borrowed" from a new generation, yet still retaining the old ideologies of what makes a 911, a 911.

Just before slipping inside of its glorious Black & Terracotta Leather cabin, you're first met by door sills featuring model insignia and when inside you can expect to find light-colored twin-stitching and aluminum/brushed aluminum/metallic-coated surfacing on select areas with deviating colored carpeting. The driver is faced with a leather-wrapped 3-spoke steering wheel, titanium-colored instrumentation dials, a centrally located dash-mounted SportChrono dial in titanium, 6.5-inch touchscreen navigation display, the precise and direct 6-speed transmission's shifter. Front occupants are embraced by Comfort seats boasting heating and cooling functionalities and can expect in-cabin audio playback via the optioned BOSE Surround Sound System, featuring 13-speakers.

description:
2007 Ford Mustang Shelby GT Premium

- Only 3,694 Miles
- Black Exterior
- Charcoal Interior
- 4.6L V8
- 5 Speed Manual Transmission

Offered here is an exceptional 2007 Ford Mustang Shelby GT Premium, one of the special Shelby-modified Mustangs produced through a collaboration between Ford and Shelby Automobiles in Las Vegas. Finished in Black Clearcoat over a Dark Charcoal Leather interior, this Shelby GT combines the timeless styling of the S197 Mustang with factory-backed Shelby performance upgrades that transformed the already capable Mustang GT into a true modern muscle car. As documented by the original window sticker and Shelby package documentation, this example carries Shelby CSM Number 07SGT4748 and was shipped directly to Shelby Automobiles for conversion.

Power comes from Ford's proven 4.6L 3-Valve V8 paired with a desirable 5-speed manual transmission. Shelby's performance enhancements included the Ford Racing Power Upgrade Package featuring a 90mm cold air intake, performance mufflers, Pro-Cal performance calibration, and a performance X-pipe exhaust system. The result is improved throttle response, a more aggressive exhaust note, and the kind of engaging driving experience enthusiasts expect from a Shelby-badged vehicle. A Hurst short-throw shifter further sharpens the driving experience, while the factory-installed 3.55 limited-slip rear axle helps put power to the pavement.

Handling was significantly upgraded through Shelby's Ford Racing Handling Package, which added performance dampers, lowering springs, front and rear sway bars, and a strut tower brace. These enhancements transformed the Mustang's road manners, providing flatter cornering and increased driver confidence. The package was complemented by the GT Appearance Package, which included side scoops, revised front and rear fascias, and 18-inch premium aluminum wheels.

Distinctive Shelby styling cues set this car apart from an ordinary Mustang GT. Features include the functional hood scoop, racing-style hood pin kit, billet grille insert with Mustang pony emblem, Shelby trunk lid lettering, "Powered by Ford" fender badges, aluminum engine plaque with Shelby serial numbering, Shelby GT aluminum door sill plates, custom floor mats, and silver racing stripes. Together, these elements create a car that is instantly recognizable as one of Shelby's limited-production creations.

According to the original window sticker, the car was originally ordered as a Mustang GT Premium Coupe and equipped with the Interior Upgrade Package, satin aluminum interior trim, and active anti-theft system. The Shelby conversion brought the total MSRP to $30,220, making it a unique factory-authorized performance package that bridged the gap between the standard Mustang GT and the legendary GT500.

With its documented Shelby pedigree, desirable manual transmission, original Shelby documentation, and unmistakable black-on-charcoal color combination, this 2007 Shelby GT Premium represents a fantastic opportunity to own one of the most collectible modern Shelby Mustangs. Blending everyday drivability with authentic Shelby performance and exclusivity, it remains a standout example of Carroll Shelby's enduring influence on the Ford Mustang legacy.

  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
